div.style: width:100vw; height:100vh; margin:0; padding:0; background:#0a0c10; color:#fff; font-family:sans-serif; overflow:hidden;
position:absolute; top:-50%; left:-50%; width:200%; height:200%; background:radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(78,201,176,0.15) 0%, transparent 60%); z-index:0;
position:relative; z-index:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:100%;

a.style: background:#4ec9b0; color:#000; padding:15px 30px; border-radius:8px; text-decoration:none; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.1rem; transition:0.2s; box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(78,201,176,0.4);
